ops.sql: SELECT o.Object_ID, o.Name, o.Object_Type, o.CreatedDate, o.ea_guid, p.Name AS Pkg FROM t_object o JOIN t_package p ON p.Package_ID = o.Package_ID WHERE o.Object_Type IN ('UseCase','Class') AND o.CreatedDate < '2026-10-11' AND p.Name LIKE 'FBT%' ORDER BY o.CreatedDate
SELECT o.Name, o.Object_Type, o.CreatedDate FROM t_object o WHERE o.Package_ID = (SELECT Package_ID FROM t_package WHERE Name = '#FB-TEST') ORDER BY o.CreatedDate DESC
